claim: Backdoor Bodega at 37 Jalan Gurdwara is an award-winning speakeasy ranked #52 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2024, hidden behind a clothing store with ever-changing menus.
quote: Backdoor Bodega - Address: 37 Jalan Gurdwara, George Town, 10300 Penang. Notable: Award-winning speakeasy ranked #52 on Asia's 50 Best Bars 2024; hidden behind a clothing store with ever-changing menus.

claim: Good Friends Club at 39 Jalan Gurdwara sits behind teal doors with a 'Good Friends Never Bojio' shophouse sign, serving kopitiam-inspired cocktails like Laksa Negroni and Penang White Curry.
quote: Good Friends Club - Address: 39, Jalan Gurdwara, 10300 George Town, Penang - Specialty: Nostalgic cocktails inspired by kopitiam culture, including Laksa Negroni and Penang White Curry

claim: Magazine 63 at 63 Jalan Magazine is one of Penang's earliest speakeasies, hidden behind a row of nondescript shophouses next to a Da Ma Cai lottery shop, open 7pm-midnight Tue-Sun.
quote: Magazine 63 is located at 63, Jalan Magazine, 10300 George Town... was one of the very first speakeasies in Penang and sparked the hidden bar trend in the city. The bar is open from 7pm to 12am from Tuesdays to Sundays.

claim: Out of Nowhere is a speakeasy entered through a large orange fridge behind the counter of Hold Up Cafe, working from 8 signature cocktails using local fruits and ingredients like pandan, nutmeg and bunga kantan.
quote: Out of Nowhere moonlights as a minimalist coffee shop by day, and a vibrant speakeasy by night. The speakeasy is accessed through a hidden entrance—a large orange fridge located behind the counter of Hold Up Cafe.

claim: Good Friends Club is open 8pm-1am, Magazine 63 opens 8pm-3am closed Mondays, and signature drinks include laksa negroni (RM45) and milo peng (RM30).
quote: Good Friends Club features an auto garage-door entrance... Signature drinks include laksa negroni (RM45) and milo peng (RM30). Opens 8PM–1AM. Magazine 63, Penang's first speakeasy... Opens 8PM–3AM (closed Mondays).

claim: Three Sixty atop the Bayview Hotel at 25-A Lebuh Farquhar combines a revolving restaurant with a spacious outdoor sky bar offering 360-degree views over UNESCO George Town and the port.
quote: Three Sixty, found on top of the Bayview Hotel in George Town, offers a fantastic and dual rooftop setting, including both a revolving restaurant and a stylish rooftop bar. It is surrounded with breathtaking 360° views over the UNESCO World Heritage George Town

claim: The Rainbow Skywalk at The Top Komtar sits 249m up on the 68th floor, open daily 10am-10pm, with Coco Cabana bar and bistro providing refreshments on the deck.
quote: Suspended at an awe-inspiring height of 249 meters on the 68th floor of Komtar Tower... open daily from 10:00am to 10:00pm. The Coco Cabana bar and bistro provides refreshments coupled with a spectacular backdrop.

claim: Soundmaker Studio at 1st Floor No 18 Lebuh Bishop is northern Malaysia's most prominent alternative music club, hosting punk, metal and experimental gigs that typically run weekends from afternoon through before midnight.
quote: Soundmaker is a haven for alternative, punk, metal, and experimental music lovers—it's raw, loud, and unforgettable. Shows are often on weekends and start in the afternoon to end before midnight

claim: China House on Beach Street is a compound of three heritage buildings linked by an open-air courtyard with 14 spaces; The Canteen at the rear offers live jazz, indie and soul music every night of the week.
quote: China House is a traditional compound of 3 heritage buildings, linked by an open air courtyard and converted into 14 spaces... The Canteen... offers a mix of jazz, indie and soul music... live music every single night of the week.

claim: China House serves around 50 different cakes and desserts daily prepared by ten bakers, with Sun-Thu hours 9am-midnight and Fri-Sat 9am-1am, making it a viable late-evening dessert stop.
quote: Between them, you can expect 50 different cakes and desserts every day, prepared by ten bakers eager to showcase new recipes.

claim: Mugshot Cafe at 302 Lebuh Chulia stays open until midnight on Saturday and Sunday (8am-10pm weekdays), known for fresh-baked bagels and a mugshot-themed photo wall.
Chulia Street Night Hawkers operates Saturdays roughly 6pm to midnight and is reportedly lively and safe even at 11pm, making it a convenient post-dinner snack walk.
quote: Chulia Street Night Hawkers operates on Saturdays from 6:00 pm to 12:00 am... The street is lively even at 23:00 and safe, according to visitor reports.

claim: George Town's historic centre is one of Malaysia's safer travel zones but quieter side lanes feel less comfortable after bars close, and Grab is the easiest late-night option costing roughly S$2 for a short ride.
quote: George Town is one of the safest places for travelers... quieter side streets lose that comfortable feel late at night... Grab is widely used and is usually the easiest option for visitors... costing around S$2 for a short 10-minute ride

claim: BISO Cocktail Bar at 63A Jalan Magazine (next door to Magazine 63) offers minimalist technique-driven menus organised as entrees/mains/desserts, while SO-OD Bar above SOOD by Chef Ton on Lebuh Farquhar pairs Thai-inflected mixology with live bands and DJs.
quote: BISO Cocktail Bar - Address: 63A Jalan Magazine... menu organized as entrees, mains, and desserts... SO-OD Bar - Address: 33 Lebuh Farquhar... located above SOOD by Chef Ton with live bands and DJs

claim: Mish Mash on Muntri Street has anchored George Town's drinking scene since 2014 with craft cocktails, craft beers and an extensive single-malt whisky list.
quote: Mish Mash has been at the forefront of George Town's drinking scene since 2014, offering mean cocktails, craft beers, and an impressive selection of international single malt whiskeys.
